biotools.summary: NeoDisc is a proteogenomic pipeline for identifying immunogenic tumor-specific antigens from multiple sources, integrating genomics, transcriptomics, and immunopeptidomics data. It enables assessment of tumor heterogeneity and the functionality of the antigen processing and presentation machinery, packaged within a Singularity container.
